name: 媽祖聖誕
message: 今天是媽祖聖誕！萬春宮、樂成宮都會舉行祝壽祭典，歡迎前來參拜祈福 🙏
messageEn: Today is Mazu's Birthday! Wanchun & Lecheng Temples are holding sacred celebrations — welcome to worship and receive blessings! 🙏

name: 安太歲
message: 安太歲登記開始囉！沖犯太歲的生肖今年適合到廟裡安太歲，點我看各廟登記方式
messageEn: Taisui registration is open! If your zodiac sign clashes with Taisui this year, visit the shrine to light a Taisui lamp 🙏

name: 中元普渡
message: 中元普渡將至，萬春宮、城隍廟均有普渡法會，需要供品或法會資訊都可以問我
messageEn: Zhongyuan Ghost Festival is coming. Wanchun & City God Temples hold grand ceremonies for peace and ancestral blessings.

name: 關聖帝君聖誕
message: 關聖帝君聖誕快到了，南天宮會有祝壽及補財庫活動，想發財運的人別錯過
messageEn: Lord Guan's Birthday is approaching! Nantian Temple will hold wealth blessing rituals — don't miss out!

name: 下元節
message: 下元節將至，水官大帝解厄消災，適合到廟裡祈求解厄平安
messageEn: Xiayuan Festival is near. The Water Deity dispels misfortune and bestows peace and harmony.

name: 冬至謝平安
message: 冬至到了，記得吃湯圓、到廟裡謝平安，感謝神明這一年的照顧
messageEn: Winter Solstice is here! Enjoy sweet tangyuan and visit the shrine to thank the deities for a blessed year.
